initial.name: reactions
initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent four-frame portrait sprite atlas for a dialogue scene in Encore, a warmly illustrated 2D platform game. Use supplied references ONLY to preserve the exact identity and established rendering of Nige Hood: his medium-brown skin, expressive dark eyebrows, short shaped beard, textured curly black afro, olive green open jacket over white crew-neck T-shirt. Crop each portrait consistently at the chest; include the complete head, afro and shoulders, no hands. Compose precisely a TWO COLUMN x TWO ROW GRID, one separate head-and-shoulders character portrait centered in each quadrant, all exactly the same scale, eye line and flattering three-quarter angle looking slightly toward screen right. Generous transparent gutters around each, no overlap, no panels or outlines around whole portraits. The expressions tell a quiet rooftop surprise: upper left neutral recognition, alert and calm, mouth relaxed; upper right curious, one eyebrow raised, head very slightly tipped as if listening; lower left wide-eyed realization with eyebrows raised and lips gently parted, surprised without caricature; lower right moved and warmly joyful, sincere broad smile, eyes soft. Match the existing richly hand-illustrated game art and clean silhouette, warm even light consistent throughout. No hats, props, party items, speech bubbles, numbers, words, glow, floor, shadow or background. Each cutout fully opaque character on actual transparent alpha zero outside the busts; the white tee must remain opaque. Square atlas.

initial.name: mic
initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. An illustrated hero collectible for Encore, a richly hand-painted urban arcade platformer: a single gorgeous GOLD MICROPHONE TROPHY. Three-quarter product view on a true transparent background, complete freestanding object with generous padding. A small low angular cut-black plinth with a brass bevel supports a cast gold sculpted HUMAN HAND and short golden wrist; the sculpted fingers visibly wrap around and grip the lower handle of a classic stage microphone. Both hand and microphone are beautifully sculpted metallic gold; the clearly recognizable domed mic grille with dark fine mesh recesses sits at the TOP, significantly above the hand, and points slightly upward/right. The cast hand must be legible as the distinctive sculptural grip, not a separate flesh-colored human holding an ordinary microphone, not a fist replacing the microphone. Strong silhouette, polished warm gold edges and deep bronze recesses, refined small cast-metal highlights and readable details at 64 pixels. Illustrated premium arcade relic rendered with crisp contours and dimensional shading, no photoreal environment, no labels or text, no floating sparkles/glow/shadow, no extra objects. Centered portrait-to-square composition, isolated opaque trophy cutout with actual transparent alpha-zero background. Keep entire base, wrist, fingers and grille inside the frame.

portraitRevision: Edit the supplied four-portrait transparent sprite atlas for an arcade-game surprise sequence. Keep the exact same character identity, complexion, black afro, short beard, green jacket, white shirt, art style, light, 2x2 placement and large head-and-shoulders scale. KEEP upper-left neutral face and lower-right happy relieved smile. Change UPPER RIGHT: BOTH eyebrows distinctly lift and his eyes visibly widen as he first notices something, mouth still closed. Change LOWER LEFT most strongly: make the expression an absolutely unmistakable anime/arcade double-take — both eyes FULLY opened, MUCH more white showing with smaller pupils, eyebrows high, lower jaw dropped and mouth wide OPEN in a big surprised 'HUH?!' oval shape with visible mouth interior and upper teeth. He is startled and amazed by a surprise party, not frightened or angry. This third face is the most dramatically exaggerated frame and must still read from a tiny thumbnail. The sequence at a glance should be neutral > raised eyebrows & wider eyes > giant eyes with jaw dropped > relieved happy smile. Do not print words or symbols. No speech balloons, marks, sweat drops, motion lines, shadows, extra objects, borders or background. Preserve genuine transparent alpha-zero beyond each bust and crisp opaque character cutouts.
